title: Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady in November 2016 meeting
text: WASHINGTON (Reuters) - The Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged on Wednesday in its last policy decision before the U.S. presidential election, but signaled it could hike rates in December as the economy gathers momentum and inflation picks up. The U.S. central bank's rate-setting committee said the economy had continued to strengthen and job gains remained solid. Policymakers also expressed increased optimism that inflation was moving toward their 2 percent target.
